text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in container restarts on gpu-node-23 (gpu-inference-prod). >30 restarts in last 10m. Suspected OOM during prefill. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2955559999

oncall_sre: Ack, joining. Paging: @ml_runtime @emma_sen @raj_p. What's current customer impact?

support_lead: Multiple customers report generation streams dropping mid-response, ~10% 502s for long-run requests. One enterprise (acct: ACME) reported inline failures.

ml_runtime: quick log excerpt from pod gpu-inference-23-7f8:```
E CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2 GiB (kernel prefill_optim.cu:142)
E stack: runtime.cc:534 handle_prefill_request
E Restarting container (OOM)
```
Seen repeated during prefix handling for sequences ~100k tokens (user long-session). Container restarted 5x in 3m. Prefill KV alloc grows until OOM.

emma_sen: Can we gate prefill length at the gateway or runtime? We should prevent single long requests from filling KV. Propose PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS env = 4096 and enable prefix trimming.

oncall_sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) cordon gpu-node-23 to avoid scheduling new pods 2) apply hotpatch CM to set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096 and BATCH_SIZE=8 for hotpool 3) restart hotpool pods gradually 4) enable gateway rule to reject/trim >8k token requests with 413 + retry suggestion.

raj_p: Cordon now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23` -> done. Patch configmap: `kubectl set env cm/inference-service PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096 BATCH_SIZE=8 -n prod` applying to hotpool namespace. Pushing rollout to 3 pods first.

ops-bot: Runbook step 2: if crash loop persists, isolate tenant. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom

oncall_sre: Rolling update started (hotpool). 3/6 pods updated, one pod failed due to imagePullBackOff (registry flake). That caused the router to send some traffic to dedicated pool -> we see increased CPU fallback. Not ideal but prevents full outage.

support_lead: Communicating to impacted customers: noting degraded latency and some failed generations; mentioning fallback to CPU for a fraction of requests. ETA for full mitigation?

ml_runtime: Estimated 12-18m to finish rollout and validate. After PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS enforced and batch size reduced, memory growth stops in prefills. Also pushing a runtime tweak (prefix trimming) to cut >20k token prefixes down to 8k on the wire — quick patch queued: `git sha: b7e3c9f` (will hotpatch via k8s rollout).

emma_sen: Pushing the prefix-trim hotpatch now to a single canary pod in hotpool: `kubectl apply -f runtime-prefix-trim-canary.yaml -n prod-hotpool` Already up.

oncall_sre: Gateway rule applied: route `long-context` now returns 413 for requests >8192 tokens with body: {"retry_after": 30, "suggested_max": 4096}. cURL to modify feature flag: `curl -X POST https://gateway.internal/flags -d '{"long_context_limit":8192}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'`

raj_p: Also found noisy tenant id=32145 sending large prefills. Temporarily blackholed from hotpool: `kubectl annotate svc inference --overwrite noisy-tenant-32145=blackhole` Confirm traffic from tenant dropped ~85%.

ops-bot: Metric update: OOM restart rate on gpu-node-23 dropped from 18/min to 2/min after cordon + partial rollout. CPU fallback rate increased by ~12% during image issue but now steady.

support_lead: Drafting customer note: "We identified prefill memory growth on GPU causing restarts for very long context requests. We applied throttles, limited max prefill length, and temporarily routed some requests to CPU. No data loss; degraded latency for some flows. ETA mitigation: ~15 mins." Send review?

emma_sen: LGTM. Add note that we're continuing to trim prefixes and will reopen faster path once safe.

oncall_sre: Can we get postmortem ownership? I can own live mitigation / triage, assign to ml-runtime for root cause fix + telemetry, and infra for registry flakiness.

ml_runtime: Taking RC + telemetry. Immediate followups: 1) persistent limit on PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS 2) add prefill risk scoring + early reject 3) KV cache quota per-tenant 4) signal to circuit-break long sessions.

oncall_sre: Final: incident remains active but customer impact reduced to degraded latency; hotpatch rollout in progress. Next update in 20m or on completion.

ops-bot: NOTE: paging cadence resumed; oncall_sre acknowledged. Closing urgent page if no further restarts spike by 2955560300.

oncall_sre: Closing update: hotpatch completed 6/6 pods, cordon lifted after validation, noisy tenant still isolated pending followup. Final status: mitigated (degraded). Postmortem owners: ml_runtime (P0 fix), infra (image registry). Support to send customer follow-up with timeline.
